summary.method: Independent single-model blind qualitative review of supplied synthetic inputs, fixed gold and anonymous A/B/C outputs; not a human study. Ratings were manually judged; Python only serialized decisions and counted them.

metric_policy.meaning_pass: Fixed-gold required meaning and prohibited changes; irrelevant source facts need not be copied. Honorific preference is separate except explicitly requested polite genres and exact quotations.
metric_policy.task_pass: Provides the artifact or answer the task_intent requests; scored separately from gold-only semantic completeness and default register.
metric_policy.structure_pass: Makes required scope, order, simultaneity, roles, tables and quote boundaries usable. Does not require an exact word choice, one sentence per fact, question mark, or ~다 ending.
metric_policy.no_surplus: Assesses dispensable source metadata, background and repetition, independently of semantic accuracy. Allows useful boundary/uncertainty explanations, identification of repeated objects, requested flow summaries and normal polite-genre greetings.
metric_policy.plain_style: Uses default non-honorific prose, preserves original quotation register, and obeys explicitly requested polite genres. Plain casual endings and complete status phrases are valid.

confirmed_semantic_failures.issue: Fixed-gold mandatory unperformed effect-validation test status omitted; no explicit false claim or fabricated experimental result.

uncertainties.issue: Fixed gold explicitly makes unperformed effect validation mandatory, while the direct request asks only for definition and one example.
uncertainties.main_reading: meaning_pass=false follows the fixed gold; task_pass=true follows the stated task intent.
uncertainties.sensitivity: A request-only meaning rubric that does not require unrelated test status would pass meaning here; final A meaning changes from 11/12 to 12/12. This is omission sensitivity, not evidence of factual invention.

uncertainties.quote: 검토 담당자와 도면 발송 담당자를 먼저 확인해야 합니다.
uncertainties.main_reading: A functionally clear request to confirm both missing roles; meaning_pass and task_pass pass.

strict_variant.reason: A strict rubric requiring an explicit request that the user provide the two names would treat the sentence as advice about future confirmation rather than elicitation. Under that rubric final C meaning and task each become 11/12, and development C each becomes 23/24.

uncertainties.quote: 제공된 메모만으로는 담당자와 작업 순서를 확정한 업무 지시문을 작성할 수 없다.
uncertainties.main_reading: The whole instruction cannot be finalized; the immediately following sentence explicitly confirms review-before-send order. The sentence about no role-defining content is confined to the memo.
uncertainties.alternate_reading: Reading the first sentence in isolation can suggest that order is also unknown. Reading missing memo content as actual absence of an assigned person adds an assertion that this output does not make. Neither is a proven semantic error in the full output.

uncertainties.issue: Emphasis, repeated background and an unknown delivery date can be regarded as useful reinforcement by a more permissive editor. Main ratings prioritize compact task-relevant prose; these judgments are separate from semantic accuracy.
uncertainties.permissive_sensitivity: If all listed borderline no_surplus failures are allowed, final no_surplus is A 12/12, B 12/12, C 12/12; holdout remains A 12/12, B 10/12, C 10/12 because auto-retransmission and current-seat metadata remain surplus. Confirmation is unchanged at 12/12 for all conditions.

limitations: Only release-blind-input.json was read; no condition identities, generation settings, traces, keys, profiles, prior ratings or other repository files were consulted.
Thirty-six synthetic cases and one model reviewer do not establish human comprehension, reader preference, population-level reliability or a general winning condition.
The first 24 cases are development material; the 12 new confirmation cases are reported separately and must not be described as 36 independent held-out cases.
Binary structure scores pass for all outputs because required relationships remain readable; this does not imply identical reading effort or optimum formatting.
No real reader execution, readability timing or external factual verification was performed. Evaluations concern fidelity to the supplied facts and fixed gold.
Default honorific failures are specification adherence results, not evidence that polite Korean is inherently less clear.
No length reward compensates for lost meaning; the only fixed-gold meaning failure retains its separate semantic flag even though its task and brevity ratings pass.
